content: Maskable/adaptive icons: Chrome and Firefox support SVG icons with purpose maskable; artwork must sit inside the safe zone or Android renders a broken small-framed icon (community reports). MDN and Lighthouse recommend 192px and 512px PNG entries plus maskable variants; PWA icon checklist 2025 suggests 192/256/384/512/1024 PNG plus SVG maskable. Keep graphic in the 80% safe zone.
